name: Rejection Reason 76 Code
definition: Specifies the reason why the instruction/cancellation request has a rejected status.

SAFE.name: Safekeeping Account Rejection
SAFE.definition: Unrecognised or invalid message sender's safekeeping account.

ADEA.name: Account Servicer Deadline Missed
ADEA.definition: Transaction/instruction received after the account servicer's specified deadline.

RTGS.name: Impossible To Use The RTGS System Instructed
RTGS.definition: Not possible to use the RTGS system instructed (NRTG or YRTG).

NCRR.name: Settlement Amount Currency Rejection
NCRR.definition: Unrecognised or invalid settlement amount currency.

DSEC.name: Invalid Security
DSEC.definition: Unrecognised or invalid financial instrument identification.

DADR.name: Address Details Rejection
DADR.definition: Address details are incorrect or cannot be recognised.

CANC.name: Option Cancelled
CANC.definition: Option is not valid; it has been cancelled by the market or service provider, and cannot be responded to. Any responses already processed against this option are considered void and new responses will be required.

INTV.name: Option Inactive
INTV.definition: Option is not active and can no longer be responded to. Any responses already processed against this option will remain valid, for example, expired option.

INVA.name: Invalid For Tax Authorities
INVA.definition: For tax reclaim, the reclaim is invalid for the tax authorities.

REFT.name: Refused By Tax Authorities
REFT.definition: Reclaim is refused by the tax authorities.

PHYS.name: Physical Settlement Impossible
PHYS.definition: Physical settlement is impossible for the instructed financial instrument.

REFE.name: Reference Rejection
REFE.definition: Instruction has a reference identical to another previously received instruction.

LACK.name: Lackof Securities
LACK.definition: Instructed position exceeds the eligible balance.

NMTY.name: Mismatch
NMTY.definition: Mismatch between option number and option type.

DCAN.name: Rejected Since Already Cancelled
DCAN.definition: Cancellation request was rejected since the instruction has already been cancelled.

DPRG.name: Rejected Since In Progress
DPRG.definition: Cancellation request has been rejected because the instruction process is in progress or has been processed.

STAT.name: Missing Statutes
STAT.definition: Missing statutes or commercial register or other legal documents.

STAM.name: Not Stamped Or Signed
STAM.definition: Financial instrument has not been stamped and/or duly signed.

SIGN.name: Invalid Signature
SIGN.definition: Registration request does not have a valid signature of the owner of the financial instrument.

SHAR.name: Shareholder Number Rejection
SHAR.definition: Unrecognised, missing or invalid shareholder number.

MINO.name: Minimum Settlement Quantity
MINO.definition: Quantity instructed is lower than the minimum existing settlement quantity for the financial instrument.

NRGM.name: No Match
NRGM.definition: More than one instruction match the criteria.

BATC.name: Processing Batch Rejection
BATC.definition: Unrecognised or invalid processing batch, that is, daytime/real-time while only possible to settle in overnight batch.

CADE.name: Transaction Call Delay
CADE.definition: Unrecognised or invalid transaction call delay.

OWNT.name: Type Of Ownership Rejection
OWNT.definition: Type of ownership indicated is not correct.

MUNO.name: Multiple Settlement Quantity
MUNO.definition: Quantity instructed is not a multiple of an existing settlement quantity lot for the financial instrument.

REQW.name: Wrong Registration Request
REQW.definition: Registration request to be completed by the buyer and to be forwarded to the issuer is wrong. You have used the registration request of a different issuer/registrar.

TXST.name: Tax Status Rejection
TXST.definition: Unrecognised or invalid tax status of the securities instructed.

REPA.name: Termination Transaction Amount
REPA.definition: Unrecognised or invalid termination transaction amount.

RREA.name: Disagreement In Registration Reason
RREA.definition: Registration reason indicated is not correct.

REQM.name: Missing Registration Request
REQM.definition: Registration request to be completed by the buyer and to be forwarded to the issuer is missing.

RERT.name: Repurchase Rate Type
RERT.definition: Unrecognised or invalid repurchase rate type.

SETS.name: Settlement System Method Rejection
SETS.definition: Unrecognised or invalid settlement system/method instructed.

DTRD.name: Trade Date
DTRD.definition: Unrecognised or invalid trade date or requested trade date or future trade date.

IIND.name: Common Reference Rejection
IIND.definition: Unrecognised, invalid or missing common reference.

PLCE.name: Place Of Trade
PLCE.definition: Unrecognised or invalid place of trade.

INNA.name: Narrative Information Rejection
INNA.definition: Unrecognised or invalid service level agreement pre-agreed narrative information.

BPAR.name: Business Partner Number Rejection
BPAR.definition: Unrecognised or invalid business partner number.

BREF.name: Bank Reference Number Rejection
BREF.definition: Unrecognised or invalid bank reference number.

BUSE.name: Type Of Order Rejection
BUSE.definition: Unrecognised or invalid type of order.

CAEV.name: Corporate Action Rejection
CAEV.definition: Corporate action pending on the financial instrument instructed.

CASY.name: Impossible Cash Settlement System
CASY.definition: Impossible standing arrangements override instruction for the cash settlement system.

DISC.name: Disagree With Call Amount
DISC.definition: Party does not agree with the call amount.

DISE.name: Disagree With Exposure Amount
DISE.definition: Party does not agree with the exposure amount.

DORD.name: Registration Request Data And Order Rejection
DORD.definition: Disagreement between the data on the registration request and the order.

FEEE.name: Fee Commission Rejection
FEEE.definition: Unrecognised or invalid fee or commission.

SETR.name: Settlement Transaction Rejection
SETR.definition: Unrecognised or invalid settlement transaction type.

VASU.name: Variable Rate Support Rejection
VASU.definition: Unrecognised or invalid variable rate support (repurchase agreement).

INPS.name: Place Of Safekeeping
INPS.definition: Unrecognised, invalid or missing place of safekeeping.

SDUT.name: Lack Of Stamp Duty
SDUT.definition: Required stamp duty information is missing.

ICUS.name: Receiving Delivering Party 2
ICUS.definition: Unrecognised or invalid client of delivering or receiving party 1.

ICAG.name: Receiving Delivering Party 1
ICAG.definition: Unrecognised or invalid participant of delivering or receiving depository.

IEXE.name: Receiving Delivering Party 3
IEXE.definition: Unrecognised or invalid client of delivering or receiving party 2.

INVE.name: Invalid Investor Party
INVE.definition: Unrecognised or invalid investor party. May be used by an executing party to reject an instruction for an investor (or portfolio) for which it is not authorised to act.

PLIS.name: Place Of Listing
PLIS.definition: Unrecognised or invalid place of listing. Used when the security identified is not listed on the market supplied.
